title: UTIITSL PAN Application Fees Structure
text:
An Applicant while submitting his/her PAN application form has to select the “e-PAN Card only, No
physical PAN Card” option on the form if the physical PAN Card is not required. Here e-mail id is mandatory and this option is applicable only if a valid/active e-mail id is mentioned by
the applicant on the form. By selecting “e-PAN Card only, No physical PAN Card” option on the PAN application form, the
applicant gets:
· No physical PAN Card. · Only an e-PAN Card in PDF format, that shall be mailed to the e-mail id mentioned by the
applicant in the application form, only if it has been provided and is valid/active. A) If the applicant submits the PAN application physically at the PAN Centres of UTIITSL :
